description: Epoch Marketplace kernel (W023) — the typed DOMAIN MODEL Epoch owns (architecture.md, binding): listing descriptors plus IMMUTABLE, content-addressed, hash-chained published versions (W011-style sealed envelopes); the closed pricing-model vocabulary (free, one-time, subscription, seat/workspace, usage-metered, hybrid, enterprise/private) as typed data only; trust metadata as W006-shaped evidence records; entitlement grant/revoke records with PURE check functions (immediate revocation; payment state is never authority — architecture lock rule 11); usage accounting as append-only typed events over the W010 event shapes; developer revenue records (record-keeping only, no payout logic); a provider-neutral PaymentPort seam expressing CHECKS and record-shaped outcomes ONLY (in-memory reference implementations — no payment processing, no credentials, no network); and the typed error taxonomy. NO monetization logic beyond record shape + validation.
